title: SII Vol. 14 No. 76 — Kottai-Karungulam
location_detail: On the north wall of the Rajasimhesvara temple
summary: This damaged inscription in Vatteluttu characters belongs to the time of Sadaiya-Maran and is dated in some year opposite to the 2nd year of his reign

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 77 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On the south wall of the Erichchavudaiyar temple
summary: This incomplete inscription of Sadaiya-Maran, the date of which is lost, refers to a certain Manabharanan-Podiyil-Velan whose wife may have provided perhaps for the burning of a lamp in the temple of Tirupottudaiya-Bhatara at Ilangoykkudi

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 78 — Sinnamanur
location_detail: On the west wall of the Lakshminarayana-Perumal temple
summary: This Tamil inscription is dated in the 46th year of a Sadaiya-Maran, whose identity with the other king of the same name is not clear, in the absence of similar records bearing such high regnal years

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 79 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the south base of the Kalanthasvamin temple
summary: This record is dated in the 3rd year opposite to the 4th year of the reign of Vira-Pandya who took the head of the Chola- and registers a gift of sheep by Solantaka Pallavaraiayn alias Maran-Adichchan of Poliyur in Poliyur-nadu for burning a lamp in the temple of god Sundara-pandya-Isvarattu-Bhata

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 80 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the south base of the Kalanathasvamin temple
date_text: This inscription is dated in the 4th year opposite to the 4th year of the same king-s reign
summary: It registers a gift of sheep by Arulali, the headman of a village in Venbu-nadu, for burning a lamp in the temple of god Sundara-Pandya-Isvarattu-Devar at Tiruchchuliyal, for the merit of his son Kandan-Devan

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 81 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On the base of a ruined shrine in the tirumulanatha temple
summary: This record dated in the 4th year opposite to the 4th year of the king, records the gift of land in Kilur-kundukalam by a tinaikkalattan of Nakkur in Venbu-nadu, for providing for the expenses of feeding some brahmanas, who chanted some portions of the Vedas in the presence of god Tiruchchalaitturai

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 82 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Kalanathasvamin temple
summary: This record dated in the 5th year opposite to the 4th year of the king-s reign relates to the assignment of the sheep belonging to the temple to several shepherds, for the supply of ghee for burning lamps therein

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 83 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the base of the west wall of the Kalanathasvamin temple
date_text: This record of Vir-Pandya is dated in the 5th year opposite to the 4th year of his reign and is damaged and incomplete
summary: It appears to enumerate the devaradiyur who were connected with the temple of Sundar-Pandya-Isvaram at Pallipadai in Tiruchchuliyal, a devadana in paruttikkudi-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 86 — Kilmattur
location_detail: On the west wall of the Manikanthesvara temple
summary: This record of Vira-Pandya is dated in the 5th year opposite to the 5th year instead of being dated opposite to the 4th year, as in the earlier records

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 87 — Kilmattur
location_detail: On the south wall of the Manikanthesvara temple
summary: The inscription in Tamil poetry is fragmentary ; but from the available portion, it can be inferred that it refers to the building of the temple at Tirumattur by a certain Tamilavel in about the 8th year of reign of Vira-Pandya

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 88 — Pallmadam
location_detail: On the west wall of the Kalanathasvamin temple
date_text: To the same king Vira-Pandya belongs this record dated in the 7th year opposite to the 4th year of his reign
summary: It registers a gift of sheep for burning a lamp in the matha of Mahavratigal attached to the temple of Sundarapandya-Isvaram at Pallipadai

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 89 — Vijayanarayanam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Manonmanisvara temple
summary: This record is dated in the 12th year of the king and refers to a gift of sheep for burning a lamp in the temple, whose name is given, namely, Manomayanisvaram at Viayanarayana-chaturvedimangalam

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 91
location_detail: below however cites the year 13 + 1. The significance of this is not clear

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 90 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the north base of the Kalanathasvamin temple
summary: This record dated in the 13th year of the reign of Vira-Pandya registers a gift of 100 sheep by a certain Arangam-Pudi alias Poliyurnattur-Muvendavelan of Suduvuin Poliyur-nadu, for burning a lamp in the temple of Sundara-Pandya-Isvaram at Pallimadai

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 91 — Srivilliputtur
location_detail: On the south wall of the mandapa in the Perumal temple
summary: This record which belongs to Vira-Pandya is dated in the year opposite to the 13th year of his reign, different from the usual method in which the years quoted were opposite to the 4th year

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 92 — Perungulam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Tiruvaludisvara temple
summary: This record, dated in the 15th year of the reign of Vira-Pandya, registers a gift of cows for maintaining a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvaludivaram in Tiruvaludi-valanadu by a private person of the same village

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 93 — Perungulam
location_detail: On the south wall of the Tiruvaludisvara temple
summary: This incomplete inscription is dated in the 15th year of Vira-Pandya and relates to the gift of buffaloes by the wife of Pandimarttanda-Pallavaraiyan alias Sennappa of Kurungudi in Manavira-valanadu, a subdivision of Tiruvaludi-valanadu, to burn a lamp in the temple of Tiruvaludisvarattu-Alvar at Pe

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 94 — Edirkottai
location_detail: On a rock close to the Sunaikanthesvara temple
summary: This inscription of the 15 + 14th year of the king relates to a gift of sheep by Achchan, a resident of the cloth merchants, quarters (aruvai-vaniya-chcheri) for burning a lamp in the temple of Sunaikkudi-Bhatara

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 95 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On the south wall of the Erichchavudaiyar temple
date_text: This record dated in the 5th year opposite to the 15th year of the king is the latest record found for him
summary: It confirms a royal order made in the 12th year of the king, which was carried into effect now

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 96 — Vijayanarayananm
location_detail: On the south wall of the Manonmanisvara temple
summary: This damaged record belongs to the reign of Vira-Pandya

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 97 — Singampatti
location_detail: On a rock in a field in Melai-Singampatti
summary: This Vatteeluttu inscription of eight short lines is engraved in early characters but owing to the condition of the rock, as well as the peculiar nature of the script, its purport cannot be clearly made out

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 98 — Anaimalai
location_detail: At the entrance into the mandapa of the cave near the Narasinga-Perumal temple
date_text: This inscription is engraved in Vatteluttu characters of the early 9th century A.D
summary: It states that a certain Nambiranbhatta-Somasi-Parivirajakar renovated (pudukku) something, which refers evidently to the mandapa, where it is found
